verdict.rationale: A design platform could plausibly ship a built-in assistant that consumes external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Penpot's own MCP server, which external agents connect to (the server role), and does not show Penpot acting as an MCP client. The Figma-to-Penpot migration claim describes an external agent connecting both products' MCP servers, not Penpot consuming third-party tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
